tickets.title: Prepare liquidity planning analysis
tickets.text: Review expected cash needs, emergency reserve targets, recurring income sources, upcoming distributions, and potential funding sources. Summarize recommended cash cushion, any portfolio trades needed to raise cash, tax considerations, and questions for the lead advisor before client discussion. Address the gap for Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp, whose wedding and travel costs (~$24,000), Mira's remaining Denver apartment rent ($1,850/month through 2024-05-31), and combined monthly spending (~$9,600) left the household below Mira's stated six-month cash reserve preference.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-18 is to address the cash reserve and remaining lease impact.

tickets.text: Review medical, life, and disability coverage choices for Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp's combined household, including Mira's Clockwork Clover Robotics newlywed enrollment window and Arlen's Paper Otter Preparatory benefit-change process.

tickets.text: Reconcile beneficiary records and replacement-income assumptions across Mira Willowdoodle's $750,000 Amber Teapot Insurance term policy, her Clockwork Clover Robotics group life (2x salary), Arlen Copperwisp's $500,000 Pocket Lantern Insurance term policy, and Arlen's Paper Otter Preparatory employer coverage.

tickets.title: Request estate document collection
tickets.text: Ask Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp to provide current estate documents, including wills, trusts, powers of attorney, health care directives, and any recent amendment pages, so the advisory team can update planning records. Mira signed a will and financial power of attorney in 2018 before the marriage; Arlen signed a will in 2016 after Pippa was born.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-12 is to collect estate document copies and any amendment pages.

tickets.title: Review mortgage and property records

tickets.evidence: Follow-up is needed by 2024-03-15 for the mortgage and property record review based on those missing property records.

tickets.title: Prepare joint tax withholding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a coordinated 2024 withholding and estimated-tax projection for Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp to share with Celia Fablethimble of Apricot Compass Tax, accounting for combined salaries, bonuses, investment income, and Mira's $42,000 capital loss carryforward from 2022.
